label: Fever after travel
note:
The patient presented with fever, sweats, generalized aching, nausea, fatigue, and alternating chills. Recent travel to Vietnam four weeks prior was reported.

The patient was advised to attend a clinic in central London for examination and blood tests. Malaria and other exotic infections were suspected. The patient was told to contact the admin team to book an appointment.
patient:
Your appointment today
You came because you had fever and aches. You also had nausea, fatigue and alternating chills. You told us you travelled to Vietnam recently.

Your diagnosis
We suspect malaria and other exotic infections. This means we think a specific infection might be in your body.

Your treatment and next steps
Please contact our admin team to book an appointment. You must go to a clinic in central London. You need to have an examination and blood tests there.

When to contact us
Call us if you have fever, sweats or aches. Call us if you have nausea, fatigue or alternating chills.
summary: A patient in their thirties presented with fever, night sweats, myalgia, and nausea following travel to Vietnam. A working diagnosis of undifferentiated fever with high suspicion for malaria was made. The patient was advised to stay home and attend a clinic for blood tests, including malaria films.

answers.happened: The travel history came out only because I asked directly, well into a fever history that had no focus. Rural travel, trekking and cycling, malaria tablets she could not name. That one question changed the consultation from a viral illness to a possible malaria.
answers.learned: Ask about travel early in any fever without a focus, and ask what the prophylaxis was rather than whether it was taken. A patient with clinical knowledge of their own still needs the same safety-netting as anyone else.
answers.next: I would ask about travel before the systems review, not after it. Writing the blood film request into the notes for whichever clinic she attended was the right call, so the handover did not depend on memory.
